papers.title: Can Generalist Agents Automate Data Curation?
papers.abstract: Curating training data is among the most consequential yet labor-intensive parts of modern AI development: practitioners iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, and revise data policies against noisy benchmark feedback. We ask whether generalist coding agents can automate this data-curation loop. papers.title: Agent Planning Benchmark: A Diagnostic Framework for Planning Capabilities in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Planning is central to LLM agents: before acting, an agent must decompose goals, select tools, reason over constraints, and decide when a task is infeasible.
